title: Gem Studio
tagline: A browser tool for composing song-pack prompts for a Google Gem, then checking what comes back.
stateNote: Runs locally with no build step. The README links to a hosted copy that returned a 404 when I checked.
problem: A prompt-driven Gem only improves if you can see what 'good' looks like. Gem Studio composes prompts, decodes the replies against a template contract, and helps save the good packs as examples.
audience: People who write songs with AI and want repeatable, checkable output.
contribution: It is my project: the Gem instructions, the template contract and the studio UI.
worksToday: Compose prompts from recipes or your own settings.
Decode a reply and flag drift from the templates.
Browse the library of example packs.
limitations: The hosted link in the README doesn't currently load.
The Gem itself runs in Google's Gemini, not here.
